clue.text: Government-funded body gives Dame Mary reduced work

indicators.note: reduced says the designer's surname is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: Dame Mary Quant, the fashion designer behind the miniskirt
to go is to work or function, as a machine does

explanation.surface: A publicly funded organisation hands commissions to a famous fashion designer, cut-price.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced' trims the T off QUANT. A quango is a British semi-independent public body funded by government.
explanation.definitionFit: A quango is a quasi-autonomous public organisation financed by the state but run at arm's length.

clue.text: Split leftover capital

parts.note: quit is a past tense of quit, meaning left or departed
O is the cricket scoring abbreviation for an over

explanation.surface: Something split off and left behind becomes a capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Split' tells you to split 'leftover' into 'left' and 'over'. Quito is the capital of Ecuador.
explanation.definitionFit: Quito is the capital city of Ecuador, high in the Andes.

clue.text: Anoint a Byzantine lady

indicators.note: Byzantine means intricate and convoluted, so the letters are tangled into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to anoint a woman of the Byzantine Empire, as in a court ceremony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Byzantine' rearranges ANOINT, and A is added at the end as printed.
explanation.definitionFit: Antonia is a woman's given name, so it stands for a particular lady.

clue.text: Serviceman captures a foul-mouthed nationalist

indicators.note: the soldier captures, holding the other letters inside him

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
ribald means coarse and vulgar in speech

explanation.surface: A soldier arrests a swearing patriot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'captures' puts A RIBALD between G and I.
explanation.definitionFit: Giuseppe Garibaldi was the Italian patriot who led the fight for Italian unification.

clue.text: Centrally heated room mostly being used for procreation

indicators.note: centrally picks the central letters of the following word
mostly says the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a study is a room for reading and writing

explanation.surface: A warm study, nearly all of it, set aside for breeding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Centrally' takes AT, the central pair of letters in HEATED; 'mostly' cuts STUDY to STUD.
explanation.definitionFit: A stallion at stud is kept for breeding, mating for a fee.

clue.text: Slender king's figure

parts.note: slender means thin
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A slim monarch's physique.
explanation.walkthrough: 'figure' looks like a noun for a body shape but is the verb, as in 'I figure so'.
explanation.definitionFit: To figure something is to reckon or suppose it, the same as to think it.

clue.text: Old stager is a cavalryman? Sounds like it

indicators.note: sounds like it says the answer is said the same as the word for a cavalryman

parts.note: a trooper is a cavalry soldier

explanation.surface: Is an experienced old actor really a horse soldier? The question mark hints it's only in name.
explanation.definitionFit: A trouper is a veteran performer, a reliable and seasoned member of a theatrical company.

clue.text: Dicky perished after overwhelming century breaks

indicators.note: the jumbled letters overwhelm, surrounding the other letter
dicky means shaky or unsound, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: A wobbly batsman got out after making a hundred, a cricket report might say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dicky' rearranges PERISHED and 'overwhelming' puts that around C. 'breaks' is the verb, as in breaks a code.
explanation.definitionFit: To break a code is to decode it, working out the hidden message.

clue.text: The bloke's right-wing past

parts.note: his means belonging to the bloke
a Tory is a British Conservative, on the political right

explanation.surface: A man's background in Conservative politics.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone's history is their past, the record of what they have done.

clue.text: Killer stalks Frenchman in Spanish location

indicators.note: a stalker follows behind, so this piece comes after the others

parts.note: M is short for Monsieur, a Frenchman
the orca is the killer whale

explanation.surface: A predator tracks a French visitor through a place in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Minorca, or Menorca, is one of Spain's Balearic Islands in the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Wife's so nimble during dance movement

indicators.note: dance sets the letters moving about into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A wife is so light on her feet while dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dance' rearranges SO NIMBLE to OMENSLIB after W; 'during' and the 's are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Women's lib was the popular name for the women's liberation campaign of the 1960s and 70s, a social movement.

clue.text: Yankee separates two poets with identical cuts in brawl

indicators.note: the letter separates, standing between the two names
with identical cuts says both poets lose the same thing, their final letter

parts.note: John Donne and Rupert Brooke, the English poets
Y is Yankee in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An American breaks up two poets, both of whom bear the same wounds, in a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: The poets are John Donne and Rupert Brooke; 'with identical cuts' means each loses the same letter, its last.
explanation.definitionFit: A donnybrook is a rowdy free-for-all fight, named after a riotous Dublin fair.

clue.text: Top bishop has Father Ted defrocked

parts.note: pop is an informal word for father

indicators.note: defrocked strips the word of its outer covering, leaving its middle

explanation.surface: The sitcom priest Father Ted is thrown out of the clergy.
explanation.walkthrough: Father Ted is a sitcom about Irish priests; 'defrocked' strips T and D from TED, leaving E.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pope is the Bishop of Rome, head of the Catholic Church and so the most senior bishop.

clue.text: Stroke stomach before beginning on legs

parts.note: a craw is a bird's crop or, loosely, the stomach

indicators.note: beginning on picks out the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Instructions to rub the belly before moving to the legs, as in a massage.
explanation.definitionFit: The crawl is a swimming stroke, the freestyle with alternating overarm movements.

clue.text: A saucer, perhaps from Ganymede?

parts.note: a saucer holds up a cup, and Ganymede was the boy who served wine to the Greek gods

explanation.surface: Is a flying saucer coming from Jupiter's moon Ganymede?
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a UFO from the moon Ganymede; the mythical Ganymede was the gods' cup carrier, and a saucer literally carries a cup.
explanation.definitionFit: A cupbearer is a servant who carries and pours drink, Ganymede's job on Olympus.

clue.text: One of Elgar's variations incorporated into finale and added to

indicators.note: incorporated into says these letters go inside the other word

parts.note: the end is the finale

indicators.note: variations, as in the Enigma Variations, says the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the composer's name Elgar, minus the possessive

explanation.surface: One of Elgar's Enigma Variations was worked into a finale and expanded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variations' nods to Elgar's Enigma Variations while signalling the rearrangement, LARGE; 'incorporated into' splits the finale word around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something enlarged has been made bigger, extended or added to.

clue.text: America supports strike on Prince Edward Island

indicators.note: in a down answer the supporting piece sits underneath the rest

parts.note: to lam is to hit hard
Ed is short for Edward
USA is America

explanation.surface: The US backs industrial action on Canada's Prince Edward Island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prince Edward Island' looks like a single place, but only 'Island' defines. Lampedusa is a small Italian island between Sicily and Tunisia.
explanation.definitionFit: Lampedusa is the largest of Italy's Pelagie Islands, in the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Holy man bores posh couples on the next floor

parts.note: U means upper-class, as in U and non-U

indicators.note: the holy man bores into the couples, going inside them

parts.note: pairs are couples
St is short for saint

explanation.surface: A saint tires the smart couples who live above.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bores' looks like tedium, but it means drilling into PAIRS.
explanation.definitionFit: Upstairs describes the floor above, one level up in a building.

clue.text: Giving a name to bird and fish

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird
a ling is a long fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: Naming a bird and a fish, as a naturalist might.
explanation.definitionFit: Titling something is giving it a title, a name.

clue.text: Bread making instruments

definitions.meaning: methods or instruments for getting something done

explanation.surface: Kitchen gadgets that make loaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Means are both money, as in living within your means, and tools or agencies for doing something.

clue.text: One lacking belief is given dabs of accessories to armed robbery

indicators.note: dabs are small touches, so only the first letters of the words are taken

parts.note: a heist is a robbery

explanation.surface: A nonbeliever is caught by fingerprints on the accomplices to a hold-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dabs' looks like slang for fingerprints, which fits the crime scene, but it means small touches, the initials A and T.
explanation.definitionFit: An atheist is someone who does not believe in any god.

clue.text: Type of music club

definitions.meaning: ... music was the 1960s guitar pop of the Merseybeat bands

explanation.definitionFit: Beat is both a style of 1960s pop and a verb for hitting, as a club does.

clue.text: Dotty made love in Doha ending early phase of chastity

indicators.note: dotty means crazy, so the letters are scrambled

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, the letter O

indicators.note: ending early says the word stops before its last letter

parts.note: Doha is the capital of Qatar

explanation.surface: Someone crazy made love in Doha, ending their early chastity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ending early' cuts DOHA to DOH; 'Dotty' scrambles MADE, O, IN and DOH together.
explanation.definitionFit: Maidenhood is the state of being a maiden, a virgin, so it is the period of chastity before marriage.

clue.text: Singular lame gags after raising a stink

indicators.note: the reversed word gags, stuffing the letter into its mouth
in a down answer, raising turns the word upwards, so it reads backwards

parts.note: to lame someone is to maim them
S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular

explanation.surface: A single poor joke that falls flat raises a stink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after raising' turns MAIM into MIAM, which 'gags' with S to give MIA-S-M.
explanation.definitionFit: A miasma, or miasm, is a foul-smelling vapour.

clue.text: Architectural feature in Kosovo location

indicators.note: in says the answer is held within the run of letters that follows

explanation.surface: A notable building in a town in Kosovo.
explanation.definitionFit: An ovolo is a convex moulding, a quarter-round profile in classical architecture.

clue.text: Lively old air, inspiring finale of Beethoven's ninth?

indicators.note: inspiring means breathing in, so the jumbled letters take the other in
lively suggests the letters jump around into a new order
finale of picks the last letter of the composer's name

parts.note: the composer's name, without the possessive

explanation.surface: A sprightly old tune that inspired the close of Beethoven's Ninth Symphony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lively' rearranges OLD AIR, and 'inspiring' takes in N. 'ninth?' looks like the symphony, but it is an example of the answer, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordinal numbers show position in order, first, second and ninth; ninth is one example.

clue.text: Ruddy German after making U-turn tailgates German car, I hear

indicators.note: to tailgate is to drive right behind, so this piece comes after the car

parts.note: Audi is a German car make

indicators.note: a U-turn sends the word back the way it came, reading backwards

parts.note: rot is German for red

explanation.surface: A furious German turns around and drives too close behind an Audi, so I'm told.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I hear' looks like a hearsay tag but is the definition: an auditor is literally one who hears.
explanation.definitionFit: Auditor comes from the Latin for listener; in the self-describing sense, an auditor says 'I hear'.

clue.text: Government, say, obstructs the return of Arab ruler

indicators.note: the example obstructs, wedging itself into the other word
the return of means the word is read backwards

parts.note: an emir is an Arab ruler
eg means for example, signalled by say

explanation.surface: A government stands in the way of an Arab ruler's comeback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' gives EG, the abbreviation for 'for example'; 'the return of' reads the ruler backwards as RIME.
explanation.definitionFit: A regime is a government, especially an authoritarian one.

clue.text: Revolutionary part of Ptolemaic astronomy

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A revolutionary idea in Ptolemy's earth-centred astronomy.
explanation.definitionFit: Fidel Castro led the Cuban revolution of 1959.
